name: WF #7a: Tally onboarding → Airtable staging (skeleton)
_note: 25 노드 (full lifecycle 보강 완료). 본체는 n8n_get_workflow id=ylRJHUCFQ9RmCa6R로 가져올 수 있음. 디스크 저장은 lightweight pointer.

_overview.trigger: Webhook (path /tally-onboarding-intake-v1, Tally 폼 제출 시 호출)
_overview.flow: Webhook → Validate & Normalize(fields[]→map, hidden 추출) → Search Existing Submission(멱등 dedupe by submission_id) → IF Already Exists → [Respond Already] / [continue] → IF Has HubSpot ID → [true: HubSpot Get Company → IF Company Found → [true: Get Associations → Extract Contact IDs → IF Has Contacts → [true: Batch Read Contacts → Forward Guard Check(email cross-check) / false: No Contacts Set] / false: Set Invalid ID]] / [false: HubSpot Search Contact by Email → Decide Match (unmatched)(email associatedcompanyid 매칭)] → Prepare Airtable Body(staging row + matched_via 통과) → Create Airtable Submission → Build Slack Message → Slack Post(#ops-onboarding) → Update Submission Slack ts → IF Should PATCH HubSpot(hubspot_company_id NOT EMPTY AND !forward_guard_flag) → [PATCH HubSpot onboarding=form submitted / skip] → Respond Success
matching_strategy_3_tier: Tier 1: hidden hubspot_id 있음 → HubSpot Company 직접 fetch → Forward 가드(associations contacts email cross-check vs form_email)
Tier 2: hidden hubspot_id 없음 → form_email로 HubSpot Contact 검색 → associatedcompanyid로 Company 추출
Tier 3: tier 1·2 다 실패 → matched_via='unmatched' (admin Slack 알림)
stub_todos_remaining: HMAC 검증 (Tally signing secret 발급 후)
gocardless_mandate_id 저장 (DD redirect 페이지 #8 구현 후)
